findings.suggested_fix:

lemma closure_pow_le : ∀ {n}, closure (s ^ n) ≤ closure s
  | 0 => by simp [pow_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      calc
        closure (s ^ (n + 1))
        _ = closure (s ^ n * s) := by rw [pow_succ]
        _ ≤ closure (s ^ n) ⊔ closure s := closure_mul_le ..
        _ ≤ closure s ⊔ closure s := sup_le_sup closure_pow_le le_rfl

@[to_additive]
lemma closure_pow_le_golf (s : Set G) : ∀ {n}, Subgroup.closure (s ^ n) ≤ Subgroup.closure s
  | 0 => by simp [pow_zero]
  | n + 1 => by
      calc
        Subgroup.closure (s ^ (n + 1))
        _ = Subgroup.closure (s ^ n * s) := by rw [pow_succ]
        _ ≤ Subgroup.closure (s ^ n) ⊔ Subgroup.closure s := Subgroup.closure_mul_le ..
